gaps: The available operations and library cases cannot send a pricing-round PATCH with only attachments and no terms_and_conditions.
read_round has no T&C fields, so retention of the written clause cannot be verified.
The plan only verifies the available live-round terms update, not the attachment-only update or clause-preservation behavior.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds.
